run_simultaneous_game_loop: run a simultaneous move game loop with game masters and entities for a given number of steps
resolve_putative_event: resolve a putative event by observing it in the game master and acting to determine outcomes
determine_next_acting_entities: determine which entities act next and their action specs using the game master
check_simulation_termination: check whether the game or simulation should terminate based on game master evaluation
make_entity_observation: make an observation for an entity by querying the game master with a call to action
